purpose: Operationalize the two Stage102 marginal-value candidates on the seven already available development targets without new docking, protected PARP1 reads, or quantum-hardware calls.
evidence_status: posthoc development amendment: Stage102 named the two candidate families before Phase-A analysis, but this amendment freezes operational bootstrap, rescue, and feature details after Phase-A docking. It can reject the route or nominate a future separately reviewed protocol; it cannot itself establish confirmation or release PARP1.

objective.primary_metric: BEDROC alpha=20 on the outer holdout; lower docking score and lower empirical rank are better
objective.primary_aggregation: minimum empirical rank across selected receptors
objective.baseline: the k=1 exact QUBO selection fitted only on each outer-training split

splits.historical_outer_split: five-fold GroupKFold on the Stage99 target group field
splits.stage102a_outer_split: the frozen outer_fold column in the received manifest
splits.inner_split: three-fold GroupKFold on the outer-training target group field

bootstrap.description: For every outer fold and k-1 to k transition, build out-of-inner-fold predictions on outer-training ligands, then resample groups with replacement and recompute paired BEDROC20 gains.

rescue.definition: A ligand is rescued at fraction f when it is absent from the top ceil(f*N) under k-1 out-of-inner-fold ranks and present under k out-of-inner-fold ranks. The contrast is active rescue fraction minus decoy rescue fraction.

feature_construction.subset_stability: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity among the three inner-fold exact QUBO subsets at the candidate k
feature_construction.rank_disagreement: Spearman correlation between k-1 and k out-of-inner-fold aggregate ranks; smaller correlation indicates greater functional novelty.
feature_construction.qubo_gap: mean inner-fold difference between the exact QUBO optimum and the direct one-swap classical solution at candidate k; this is a bounded optimization-disagreement feature rather than an exhaustive second-best gap
feature_construction.common_feature_policy: Only features computable for every one of the seven targets enter the Ridge model. Three-seed features and structural coordinates are retained as separate robustness diagnostics because they are not available consistently for all historical targets.

mechanistic_bootstrap_lcb.continue_condition: bootstrap BEDROC20 lower 95% bound > 0 and mean(top1 rescue contrast, top5 rescue contrast) > 0
mechanistic_bootstrap_lcb.stop_policy: start at k=1; stop permanently at the first failed k-1 to k transition

target_held_out_l2_ridge.training: For each held target, fit only on marginal edges from the other six targets. The held target's outer gains are never used to fit, scale, or select the model.
target_held_out_l2_ridge.continue_condition: held-target Ridge predicted outer BEDROC20 gain > 0
target_held_out_l2_ridge.stop_policy: start at k=1; stop permanently at the first nonpositive predicted transition

comparators: sequential paired marginal LCB from Stage100
direct BEDROC forward greedy at the same selected cardinality
mean singleton Top-k at the same selected cardinality
outer oracle-k, reported only as an unattainable ceiling

phase_a_gate.pass_action: Nominate the single best eligible candidate for independent protocol review. PARP1 remains locked until that review freezes an untouched-validation package.
phase_a_gate.failure_action: Reject this operationalization of adaptive-cardinality development. Do not prepare or dock PARP1 and do not run quantum hardware.
